dotnet_separate_import_directive_groups #

Exactly one blank line between two adjacent using directives in different groups, and exactly none between two in the same group. ⚠ A formatting key, not an arrangement one: the oracle performs both directions under CSReformatCode alone, and it is read in PhaseOneOptions and resolved in CSharpDocumentBuilder.ImportGroupSeparation since SK-DIV-0074 — the arranger's copy is gone, so skala format and skala arrange can no longer disagree about it. ⚠ The group is (kind, first segment) and not the first segment alone: using System.Text; and using static System.Math; share a segment and are separated, because a plain directive, a using static and an alias are three kinds. Aliases are one group whatever they alias. A gap holding a comment is not this key's at either value.
